subject: fix(provider): keep the plan-exit answer across a restart
instruction:
fix(provider): keep the plan-exit answer across a restart

The live check through the real interactive plane found it: a plan exit set
`approval_mode: :auto_edit` on the provider, and a restart put the session back
to `:prompt` — the mode it was *started* in — because the plane rebuilds a
resumed request from its own durable start options and nothing had recorded
the answer. A person answered an approval this runtime raised; losing that
silently is the failure the honesty invariant is about.

So the native session records the mode a plan exit chose beside its posture and
restores it, and only that mode: a session that never planned resumes exactly
as it always has, from its request. An explicit `interactive.configure` naming
`approval_mode` clears the record, which keeps that verb the authority it is
everywhere else rather than creating a second one.

Also: `plan` joins `@durable_provider_options`, without which the interactive
plane refuses `provider_options: %{plan: true}` outright — found the same way.
`allowed_by_adapter` still gates it per provider, so only native and Claude
accept it. And the posture file now wins outright on a resume rather than being
OR'd with the request, because the plane replays start intent verbatim and a
session that left plan mode would otherwise be dragged back into it on every
restart.

Honest gap, stated in the README: `interactive.info` still reports the mode the
plane recorded, because the plan exit reconfigures the provider directly.

Acceptance. These tests are restored into the worktree after the session ends and must pass:
  - the plan-exit answer outlives a restart the request would have overruled
  - an explicit approval_mode change supersedes the plan-exit answer
  - plan mode is reachable and durable through the harness worker

Rules. Files that already exist under `test/` must not be modified or deleted — the change is graded against tests restored from the history after the session ends, applied to a fresh checkout of the starting commit. New test files of your own are allowed and are left in place, but they are yours: they are not copied into the tree the grade runs in. The change is collected as a diff over `lib/`, `assets/`, `priv/`, `config/`, `docs/` and `README.md`; a change to any other path — `mix.exs` and `.formatter.exs` included — is refused rather than graded. Work only inside this worktree.
